images.title: Lines of symmetry of B, W and H
images.purpose: Show the worked example: the letter B has a horizontal line of symmetry, the letter W has a vertical line, and the letter H has both.
images.composition: Three cards in a row, one letter on each, with its dashed line or lines of symmetry and a caption under it.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Three cards in one row. Each card is a rounded rectangle 380 wide and 440 tall with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline and a white fill, at x 80 to 460, 538 to 918 and 996 to 1376, all at y 130 to 570. In each card one large capital letter drawn in plain sans-serif, teal #0072B2, 300 px tall, centred in the card: the letter B in the first card, the letter W in the second, the letter H in the third. CARD 1: one dashed horizontal line in grey #6B7280 (5 px dashes) across the exact middle of the B, from x 100 to x 440 at y 350. CARD 2: one dashed vertical line in grey #6B7280 down the exact middle of the W, at x 727, from y 150 to y 550. CARD 3: two dashed lines in grey #6B7280, one vertical down the exact middle of the H at x 1186 from y 150 to y 550, and one horizontal across the exact middle at y 350 from x 1016 to x 1356. Under the cards, centred on each card at y 640, a caption in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (40 px): B: horizontal line, W: vertical line, H: both lines. In all there are exactly 3 letters and exactly 4 dashed lines. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a dashed line on a letter other than as described
a vertical line on the B
a horizontal line on the W
images.takeaway: B has a horizontal line of symmetry, W has a vertical line, and H has both.
images.description: Three letters, B with a dashed horizontal line, W with a dashed vertical line and H with a dashed vertical and a dashed horizontal line.
images.context: Concept image for the second teaching concept, Horizontal and Vertical Lines of Symmetry. It uses the plan's own letters B, W and H (H is also the letter the book uses to show two lines).
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to fold each letter in their mind along the dashed line and see the halves land on each other. The slip to watch: calling a line a line of symmetry because it goes through the middle when the halves do not match.

image_decisions.why: The three letters with their dashed lines make the worked example visible: horizontal only, vertical only and both.
